# The Doll Scout

Independent collectible-toy guides and free collection tools. Focus: eight brand guides with probability, budget, collection progress and display planning. Not a toy seller or official authentication service. No live stock, popularity, resale-price or investment-return claims.

- [Collectible toy guides & free collection tools](https://thedollscout.com/) (en): Explore eight collecting worlds, from Labubu and Jellycat to SMISKI and HIRONO. Choose a series, understand what you are buying and make room for the pieces you love.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/home.txt
- [Labubu / THE MONSTERS — Calculate a style’s odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/labubu) (en): Start with the exact series and format. THE MONSTERS figures, vinyl plush and pendants are different products.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/labubu.txt
- [SKULLPANDA — Calculate style odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/skullpanda) (en): Explore the design, then check the format. A figure series and a plush pendant series need separate size and contents checks.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/skullpanda.txt
- [Jellycat — Check plush size & fit](https://thedollscout.com/brands/jellycat) (en): Choose a character, size and use. The same name can appear in several sizes, so compare the full product details before buying.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/jellycat.txt
- [Sonny Angel — Calculate my target’s odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/sonny-angel) (en): Find the series you like, then use the official regional store and retailer directory to check where you buy.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/sonny-angel.txt
- [SMISKI — Calculate style odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/smiski) (en): Build a small scene around the poses you like. The official Living Series page identifies six regular poses and a randomly distributed secret; it does not give a numerical secret rate.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/smiski.txt
- [HIRONO — Calculate style odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/hirono) (en): Use HIRONO Mime as a concrete starting point, then compare the exact piece with the scene you want to build. A whole-set assortment and separate loose boxes need different probability models.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/hirono.txt
- [DIMOO — Calculate style odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/dimoo) (en): Pick a theme before chasing a complete shelf. Animal Kingdom is a figure release; record its exact identity so other DIMOO formats do not get mixed into the same checklist.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/dimoo.txt
- [MOLLY — Calculate style odds](https://thedollscout.com/brands/molly) (en): Match the full MOLLY format and release. MEGA SPACE MOLLY 100% Series4 lists Basic, Regular, Special and Secret labels; those labels alone do not establish equal probabilities.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands/molly.txt
- [Sammelfiguren: Ratgeber und kostenlose Werkzeuge](https://thedollscout.com/de/) (de): Acht Sammelwelten entdecken, von Labubu und Jellycat bis SMISKI und HIRONO. Serie auswählen, den Kauf verstehen und Platz für die Lieblingsstücke schaffen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/home.txt
- [Labubu / THE MONSTERS — Chancen einer Figur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/labubu) (de): Zuerst Serie und Format bestimmen. Figuren, Vinyl-Plüsch und Anhänger von THE MONSTERS sind unterschiedliche Produkte.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/labubu.txt
- [SKULLPANDA — Chancen einer Figur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/skullpanda) (de): Design entdecken, dann Format prüfen. Figurenserien und Plüschanhänger benötigen eigene Maß- und Lieferumfangsprüfungen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/skullpanda.txt
- [Jellycat — Plüschgröße und Platz prüfen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/jellycat) (de): Figur, Größe und Verwendungszweck auswählen. Derselbe Name kann mehrere Größen bezeichnen; vor dem Kauf alle Produktangaben vergleichen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/jellycat.txt
- [Sonny Angel — Chancen meiner Wunschfigur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/sonny-angel) (de): Eine passende Serie wählen und anschließend den regionalen Händler über das offizielle Verzeichnis prüfen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/sonny-angel.txt
- [SMISKI — Chancen einer Figur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/smiski) (de): Eine kleine Szene aus Lieblingsposen gestalten. Die offizielle Living-Series-Seite nennt sechs Standardposen und ein zufällig verteiltes Secret, aber keine numerische Secret-Chance.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/smiski.txt
- [HIRONO — Chancen einer Figur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/hirono) (de): HIRONO Mime bietet einen konkreten Einstieg. Die gewünschte Figur mit der geplanten Szene vergleichen. Komplettset und einzelne lose Boxen brauchen unterschiedliche Wahrscheinlichkeitsmodelle.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/hirono.txt
- [DIMOO — Chancen einer Figur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/dimoo) (de): Ein Thema wählen, bevor das ganze Regal gefüllt wird. Animal Kingdom ist eine Figurenserie; ihre genaue Bezeichnung verhindert Verwechslungen mit anderen DIMOO-Formaten.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/dimoo.txt
- [MOLLY — Chancen einer Figur berechnen](https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/molly) (de): Das vollständige MOLLY-Format und die Veröffentlichung prüfen. MEGA SPACE MOLLY 100% Series4 nennt Basic, Regular, Special und Secret; diese Namen belegen keine gleichen Chancen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/brands/molly.txt
- [潮玩收藏指南与免费收藏工具](https://thedollscout.com/zh/) (zh): 探索八个收藏方向，从 Labubu、Jellycat 到 SMISKI、HIRONO。挑选系列、读懂购买规则，也为喜欢的收藏留好位置。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/home.txt
- [Labubu / THE MONSTERS — 计算想要款式的概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/labubu) (zh): 先确认具体系列和形态。THE MONSTERS 的手办、搪胶毛绒和挂件是不同产品。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/labubu.txt
- [SKULLPANDA — 计算款式概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/skullpanda) (zh): 先选喜欢的设计，再核对产品形态。手办系列和毛绒挂件需要分别确认尺寸与包装内容。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/skullpanda.txt
- [Jellycat — 测算毛绒摆放空间](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/jellycat) (zh): 按角色、尺寸和用途选择。同一个名字可能有多个尺寸，购买前需要核对完整产品信息。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/jellycat.txt
- [Sonny Angel — 计算想要款式的概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/sonny-angel) (zh): 先找到喜欢的系列，再通过官方分地区店铺及零售商目录核对购买渠道。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/sonny-angel.txt
- [SMISKI — 计算款式概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/smiski) (zh): 围绕喜欢的姿态布置一个小场景。官方 Living Series 列出六个常规姿态及随机出现的隐藏款，但未提供数字化隐藏概率。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/smiski.txt
- [HIRONO — 计算款式概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/hirono) (zh): 从 HIRONO Mime 这样的具体系列开始，再选择符合场景的角色。整套配货与单独散盒需要不同的概率模型。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/hirono.txt
- [DIMOO — 计算款式概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/dimoo) (zh): 先选主题，再考虑是否集齐一整架。Animal Kingdom 是手办系列，记录准确名称，避免把不同 DIMOO 形态混在同一清单中。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/dimoo.txt
- [MOLLY — 计算款式概率](https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/molly) (zh): 核对 MOLLY 的完整形态与系列。MEGA SPACE MOLLY 100% Series4 标注 Basic、Regular、Special、Secret 等类别，这些名称本身不能证明各款等概率。
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/zh/brands/molly.txt

  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/brands.txt
- [Free collector tools](https://thedollscout.com/collector-tools) (en): A calculator for the next decision: probability, budget, collection progress or display space.

- [Collecting field guide](https://thedollscout.com/collecting) (en): Practical answers with worked examples, explicit limits and sources you can check.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting.txt
- [Which blind-box probability model fits?](https://thedollscout.com/collecting/blind-box-rules) (en): Use independent-draw math only when each box has the same chance and previous outcomes give no information about the next one.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting/blind-box-rules.txt
- [Check a toy retailer before paying](https://thedollscout.com/collecting/check-retailers) (en): Begin with the official regional store or directory, then verify the exact seller and item. Product photos and a familiar logo do not establish authorization.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting/check-retailers.txt
- [Measure a display that actually fits](https://thedollscout.com/collecting/display-checklist) (en): Use the empty inside space and the full outline of the object in its intended pose. Outside box dimensions and nominal toy height are not enough.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting/display-checklist.txt
- [Start a collection you can keep enjoying](https://thedollscout.com/collecting/start-a-collection) (en): Choose a small theme, a spending limit and a place to display it. A clear wish list is more useful than treating every new release as a missing piece.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting/start-a-collection.txt
- [Blind boxes or a confirmed figure?](https://thedollscout.com/collecting/budget) (en): Set a spending limit and compare independent boxes with an all-in quote for the exact figure you want.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting/budget.txt
- [How many new styles could I add?](https://thedollscout.com/collecting/duplicates) (en): Estimate new regular styles and repeats before opening more independent boxes from one series.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/collecting/duplicates.txt
- [How TDS builds its guides](https://thedollscout.com/editorial) (en): The Doll Scout is an independent guide and tool publisher. We help collectors make a plan; we do not sell the featured toys or certify them.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/en/editorial.txt

- [Welches Blindbox-Modell passt?](https://thedollscout.com/de/collecting/blind-box-rules) (de): Unabhängige Ziehungen nur nutzen, wenn jede Box dieselbe Chance hat und frühere Ergebnisse nichts über die nächste verraten.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/collecting/blind-box-rules.txt
- [Spielzeughändler vor der Zahlung prüfen](https://thedollscout.com/de/collecting/check-retailers) (de): Beim offiziellen regionalen Shop oder Verzeichnis beginnen und dann Verkäufer und Artikel abgleichen. Bilder und Logos allein belegen keine Autorisierung.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/collecting/check-retailers.txt
- [Eine wirklich passende Vitrine ausmessen](https://thedollscout.com/de/collecting/display-checklist) (de): Den freien Innenraum und die vollständige Kontur in der gewünschten Pose nutzen. Außenmaße und nominelle Figurenhöhe reichen nicht.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/collecting/display-checklist.txt
- [Eine Sammlung beginnen, die Freude macht](https://thedollscout.com/de/collecting/start-a-collection) (de): Ein kleines Thema, eine Ausgabengrenze und einen Ausstellungsplatz wählen. Eine klare Wunschliste hilft mehr, als jede Neuerscheinung als fehlendes Stück zu sehen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/collecting/start-a-collection.txt
- [Blindboxen oder bestätigte Figur?](https://thedollscout.com/de/collecting/budget) (de): Eine Ausgabengrenze setzen und unabhängige Boxen mit einem Gesamtangebot für die Wunschfigur vergleichen.
  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/collecting/budget.txt

  Text: https://thedollscout.com/collector-assets/text/de/collecting/duplicates.txt

- [展示柜尺寸，怎样测才真的放得下？](https://thedollscout.com/zh/collecting/display-checklist) (zh): 测量空柜内部可用空间，以及物品在实际摆放姿态下的完整外形。盒体外尺寸和标称高度都不够。
